description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/weno5_D_periodic. Every binding loads fixture.esm (N bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the spatial D(u,x) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior WENO5-Z conservative flux-difference aggregate over [4,6]; the five periodic-wrap faces at i in {1,2,3,7,8}), the imported interior stencil inlined, with zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, and the free name dx surviving. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
